consequence.statement: The bump is confined to the /hack/api-docs developer tooling; the evidence states no effect on deployed external-secrets components, so an operator who does nothing sees no operational change.

assertion.statement: The 0.16.0 release bumps the urllib3 dependency used by the /hack/api-docs developer tooling from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence locates the bump only in the /hack/api-docs developer tooling; it names no Helm value, image, CLI flag, manifest field or other deployed surface, so no environment condition can determine exposure.
